text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back to the Dojo Invitational! In this corner, the pressure fighter with a photo-built head and a charcoal rash guard, standing one point seven nine meters tall! Last time the roundhouse showed a little too much daylight, but a hidden shorts liner and re-derived shorts weights closed the see-through and the hip split. Realism climbs from thirty-nine to forty! Still got a shiny pleated collar, a jagged jaw-to-neck seam and boxy shorts, but we love you anyway! Introducing the Boss of the Building, THE OWNER!
